upload.title: Upload the ad
upload.text: Upload a PDF or image to start a review.

analyze.title: Analyze copy and photos
analyze.text: AI checks the copy and photos separately for possible violations.

resolve.title: Decide per phrase
resolve.text: When analysis is done, choose how to handle each phrase.

report.title: Report
report.text: When analysis ends, the result is the report. Each phrase decision updates it.

roles.title: Split roles in-house
roles.text: Marketing submits as a writer, and legal or regulatory staff decide phrases as reviewers. The account that creates the workspace becomes the admin.

basis.note: Legal grounds for each flagged phrase
basis.title: Attach legal grounds
basis.text: For every phrase AI flags, it attaches the articles found in the loaded Cosmetics Act.

originals.title: Keep the originals
originals.text: Uploaded originals are kept on the server with the results and phrase decisions, so you can view them again in review and reports.

versions.label: Phrase decisions
versions.title: Fix each phrase in place
versions.text: For every flagged phrase, keep it, adopt the rewrite, edit it yourself or ask for another rewrite, and change it any time.

report.title: Keep a report
report.text: Phrases to check, evidence, patents, photo review and phrase decisions in a single report.
report.name: Review report
report.note: Phrases to check, evidence, patents, photo review, phrase decisions

tenant.label: Workspace
tenant.title: One workspace per company
tenant.text: Each company has its own workspace, so accounts only see their own company's ads and history.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What people check most before submitting a review.

publish.q: Can I publish based on the AI result alone?
publish.a:
AI flags possible violations with grounds and alternative wording.
Your company makes the final call on publishing.
It does not replace association advice or government certification.

files.a: PDFs and images (JPG, PNG, WEBP). Text PDFs, scanned PDFs and long images are split on the server, and there is no screen for typing copy directly.

originals.q: What happens to the files I upload?
originals.a: They are kept on the server with the review results and phrase decisions. You can view them again in review and report screens; submit a revised ad as a new review.

legal.q: Where do the legal grounds come from?
legal.a:
Related articles are found in the loaded Cosmetics Act.
Every phrase AI flags is shown with its legal grounds.

privacy.q: Can other companies see our files?
privacy.a: No. Each company has its own workspace, and accounts can only access their own company's data.

cost.a: Usage billing for reviews is not connected yet. The credit top-up screen only runs test payments.

cta.lead1: Creating a workspace sets up an admin account,
cta.lead2: and you can submit your first review right away.
cta.existingNote: Log in with your existing email and password.
